label: Kraken (spot)
terms_note: Public market-data endpoints only (no API key). Spec: https://docs.kraken.com/openapi/spot-rest.yaml (OpenAPI 3.0). Every response is HTTP 200 {"error": [...], "result": {...}}; failures are a non-empty error list (live 2026-10-01: pair=NOPEUSD -> 200 {"error":["EQuery:Unknown asset pair"]}). Ticker and OHLC results are keyed by Kraken's internal pair name (XBTUSD -> XXBTZUSD), not the requested one. OHLC ignores any count and answers up to 720 candles; the server keeps the newest `limit`.

error_kinds.note: an unknown pair is a 200 envelope failure

list_markets.note: Every tradable pair (altname such as XBTUSD, wsname XBT/USD, Kraken base/quote asset codes such as XXBT/ZUSD); sorted and paged locally; `query` is a case-insensitive substring of the pair names.

get_ticker.note: symbol is a pair altname such as XBTUSD or ETHEUR (list_markets). volume is the rolling 24h base volume (v[1]).

get_candles.note: interval: 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d, 1w, 15d. Kraken answers up to 720 candles whatever is asked; the newest `limit` are returned (oldest first).

not_offered.me: Account endpoints (/private/*) need API-Key + API-Sign (HMAC-SHA512 over nonce and payload); public-data entry only.
not_offered.get_balances: POST /private/Balance needs an API key with 'Funds permissions - Query'; public-data entry only.
not_offered.list_orders: POST /private/OpenOrders needs an API key; public-data entry only.
not_offered.place_order: POST /private/AddOrder needs an API key and spends money; not mapped in this public-data entry.
not_offered.cancel_order: POST /private/CancelOrder needs an API key; not mapped in this public-data entry.
